description: PAID: rent <label>.448c.net for a year and point it where you say -- A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT records, so you can hold a TLS certificate by DNS-01 and pass domain-trust checks without a registrar account, a card or a human. The paying wallet owns the name. Returns the name, its owner and when it expires; repoint it with dns_set_records, extend it with dns_renew. Call it once without payment to receive the price as an x402 PaymentRequired (Base USDC, and Solana USDC where offered); call it again with a signed payment in _meta['x402/payment'] to complete it. The receipt comes back in _meta['x402/payment-response']. No account, no API key. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST /feedback on this host -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

label.description: The label to rent, without the zone: it becomes <label>.448c.net. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; some labels are ours and refused.

records.description: What the name resolves to. The route states the record and TTL limits in details.expected on any refusal.

ttl.description: Seconds, within the range the route states in details.expected.

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT. TXT is how you pass a DNS-01 certificate challenge.

value.description: The record value: an address, a hostname, or the TXT string.

name: dns_rent
title: Rent a name under 448c.net (paid, x402)
